zoneNames.query: SELECT name FROM sys.time_zone_info ORDER BY name

results.name: local 1900-01-15T12:00:00
results.query: SELECT z.name AS zone_name,v.value,CONVERT(VARCHAR(40),v.value) AS rendered,DATEPART(TZOFFSET,v.value) AS offset_minutes FROM sys.time_zone_info z CROSS APPLY (VALUES (CAST('1900-01-15T12:00:00' AS DATETIME2(7)) AT TIME ZONE z.name)) v(value) ORDER BY z.name
